📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By KIERAN GILL, MAIL SPORT REPORTER.

Published: 01:47 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 04:11 EST, 22 November 2026.

We do not know why Cole Palmer headed for the tunnel in a huff after full-time while others in the same Chelsea side paraded the pitch to thank those supporters who had stayed to the end.

Perhaps he was frustrated with himself after a performance in which he did not score, assist, or even test James Trafford in Leeds United’s goal. Maybe he did not fancy thanking those who had been booing as Chelsea trailed 4-1. It is possible he simply does not like losing.

Most superstars can feel the same, and they can show their stroppy side when the game is not going their way.

An extreme example is Bruno Fernandes. Manchester United fans have long accepted his reputation as the Premier League’s temperamental nonpareil because of the numbers he can produce with the whingeing, albeit not so much this season during their downturn.

Such names can get away with petulance when their performances are proper, though Palmer has no such justification currently. The 24-year-old Englishman, unfortunately for Chelsea, put up another anonymous 90 minutes.

We could see he was frustrated even while on the pitch towards the end, with the way he was performatively kicking passes backwards as if to tell everyone else he had no other option. We have seen that before when Chelsea are losing, and it can be somewhat unhelpful when the pressure is being piled on the manager. It indicates the tactical set-up is not to his liking.

Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro were involved in a frosty exchange following Chelsea's 4-1 home defeat by Leeds. Source: Instagram/farihaxchels.

As the biggest name within this Chelsea team and a player whose profile transcends his team-mates’, like it or not, he is the totem when it is all going wrong.

Industry observers note that we wax lyrical when he is at his brilliant best. It can be as if there has been an explosion at a praise factory when he is dropping that shoulder to down a helpless defender. We know how terrifically talented he is. He is still compared to that 2023-24 season when his statistics were, in a wonderful way, stupid.

But when he is not performing, so too does he need to take the medicine of disapproval, which came in the form of a chorus of boos aimed at all those in Chelsea shirts at Stamford Bridge.

Leeds had not won at this ground since 1999. They corrected history, then Complaining Cole showed up at full-time.

His reaction did not speak to the cultural reset which Chelsea hoped they had orchestrated in the summer when they finally signed some experience for the changing room, bringing in Danny Welbeck, the 35-year-old whom Palmer has nominated as their upcoming ‘Unc’ after Tosin Adarabioyo’s departure, and Jordan Henderson, 36.

It was a poor show from someone who, in his fourth season at a club that gave him his chance when spending £42.5million to sign him from Manchester City in 2023, should be seen as a leader by now.

Sources indicate that palmer is, probably, still undroppable. Alonso would create an almighty problem for himself if he suddenly relegated his No10 to the substitutes’ bench when playing Nottingham Forest next week. But he is in danger of such conversations cropping up at a time when he should want to be impressing enough to get back into Thomas Tuchel’s England squad at the next opportunity.

According to recent reports, we are told both Palmer and Levi Colwill are desperate to represent their country again, but neither are performing to that standard of late. Colwill is a defender devoid of confidence, questioning himself and making mistakes. There was one moment during this demoralising defeat by Leeds when he booted a long ball straight out of play and reprimanded himself for it.

According to recent reports, colwill is perfectly capable of playing a good game. You do not have multiple clubs including Bayern Munich making enquiries with Chelsea without being considered elite. He is in a bad spell, and can come back from it, just like Palmer.

Inevitably, the response of some on social media was to say that Alonso’s time should be up.

For clarity, he is not under threat of suddenly being sacked by those at the top of Chelsea. He is 11 Premier League games into his career, and, clearly, deserves time.

According to recent reports, the tactics are on him, absolutely. But he is also dealing with a few problems outside of his control, such as holes in his squad and injuries inflicted, like his highly-influential vice captain Moises Caicedo having to be substituted after 22 minutes in this match.

Xabi Alonso has made errors but was rightly considered a huge coup when Chelsea landed him.

According to recent reports, when appointed head coach of Bayer Leverkusen in October 2022, they went through patches in the Bundesliga. First, they beat Schalke 4-0, which was good. Then they failed to win any of their next three fixtures, which was bad.

Then they won five in a row – happy days. Then they won only one of their following five – bad days. Then they won five in a row again – perfect. Then they won only one of their next seven – pitiful.

But the following season, Leverkusen won the Bundesliga without losing a single game. Alonso was considered an almighty coup when secured in the summer. A little patience is deserved from my perspective, even if Chelsea are presently in a dismal spell.

It is hard not to think Malo Gusto’s time at Chelsea is almost at an end.

He was priced out of a move in the summer when the club asked for £75million, with Liverpool, Manchester City and others across Europe indicating their interest in that window.

Malo Gusto cut a lonely figure after being beaten for Leeds's fourth goal.

But the 23-year-old Frenchman has shown little worth as the season has progressed.

Gusto started in five of Alonso’s first six games in all competitions at the beginning of the campaign.

Since then, he has been handed one start in eight, and that was in the Carabao Cup at Liverpool. Coming on as a substitute in this loss to Leeds, he tried and failed to play Brenden Aaronson offside and was then beaten by his man as the visitors made it 4-1.

We should expect to hear more on Gusto’s situation as January approaches.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

L'archiviazione del filone d'inchiesta sulle presunte interferenze nella sala VAR di Lissone continua a far discutere. Tra i passaggi più significativi del provvedimento del gip di Monza c'è la decisione di dichiarare inammissibile l'opposizione presentata dalla Fondazione Jdentità Bianconera.

Scegli Fcinter1908.it come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

Sulla vicenda è intervenuto l'avvocato Michele La Francesca, che attraverso il proprio profilo X ha ricordato di aver sollevato, già nei mesi precedenti, dubbi sulla legittimazione processuale della Fondazione. Questo il suo intervento:.

It has been revealed that «Non era storytelling: il GIP dichiara inammissibile l’opposizione della Fondazione Jdentità Bianconera. A volte è sufficiente aspettare che a parlare siano i provvedimenti giudiziari.

Qualche tempo fa avevo pubblicato un’analisi sulla legittimazione della Fondazione Jdentità Bianconera a proporre opposizione alla richiesta di archiviazione nel procedimento relativo alle presunte interferenze nella sala VAR di Lissone.

La mia posizione era chiara: prima ancora di discutere il merito delle indagini richieste, esisteva un problema preliminare di legittimazione processuale. Le finalità statutarie della Fondazione e la rappresentanza degli interessi della tifoseria juventina non erano, a mio avviso, sufficienti a conferirle la qualità necessaria per esercitare i diritti della persona offesa in un procedimento per frode sportiva.

Recent findings suggest that la Fondazione replicò con un lungo intervento pubblico, arrivando a definire le ricostruzioni che negavano o mettevano in dubbio la sua legittimazione processuale una forma di “mistificazione” e di “storytelling da social”. Altri preferirono ricorrere agli attacchi personali, arrivando persino a definirmi “parafangaio” per aver osato sostenere una posizione contraria a quella della Fondazione.

Oggi il GIP di Monza ha dichiarato inammissibile l’opposizione della Fondazione, rilevando che non è titolare dell’interesse direttamente protetto dalla norma incriminatrice e non dispone di un diverso titolo per esercitare i diritti e le facoltà della persona offesa.

Esattamente il profilo giuridico che avevo individuato e sul quale avevo espresso le mie perplessità».

Non ho intenzione di restituire le offese ricevute, né di trasformare una questione giuridica in una rivalsa personale.

Una considerazione, però, credo sia legittima: prima di liquidare come mistificazioni le argomentazioni di chi la pensa diversamente, o peggio ancora di ricorrere agli insulti, sarebbe opportuno confrontarsi con le ragioni giuridiche esposte.

Perché il diritto non si stabilisce attraverso il numero dei sostenitori, le appartenenze o i comunicati sui social.

E oggi, almeno su questa specifica questione, gli atti e la decisione del giudice parlano abbastanza chiaramente.

Non era storytelling. Era un’analisi giuridica. E il tempo, questa volta, ne ha confermato la fondatezza».

In casa Napoli c’è ottimismo dopo il buon risultato a Manchester, un pari che regala buone sensazioni in vista delle prossime gare. Uno dei migliori in questo periodo è Scott McTominay e ieri nel prepartita del match il Ds Giovanni Manna ha incontrato a Manchester l’agente del giocatore e si è parlato del rinnovo.

Come riporta il Corriere dello Sport il club ha manifestato al giocatore l’intenzione di rinnovare il contratto, lo scozzese è fondamentale e anche in queste ultime gare ha dimostrato la sua importanza nella squadra di Allegri. Ma il procuratore del calciatore ha manifestato a Manna e alla società l’intenzione di veder riconosciuta quest’importanza.

It has been revealed that come riporta il Corriere dello Sport Scott McTominay vuole ben 10 milioni di euro all’anno, un ultimo grande contratto che lo determini come uomo chiave all’interno del club, fondamentale anche in chiave futura. Il Napoli vuole accontentare il giocatore, ma ovviamente bisognerà trovare un punto di incontro.

Gli addii di Anguissa e De Bruyne a fine stagione potrebbero facilitare, ma occorre trovare un’intesa e non sarà semplice. Il quotidiano parla di inverno piuttosto freddo e intenso nelle dinamiche del club partenopeo.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

La campagna coinvolge sei calciatori e calciatrici delle Nazionali e rinnova l’invito a comporre il 1522.

According to recent reports, la FIGC rinnova il suo impegno contro la violenza sulle donne con una campagna di sensibilizzazione affidata a sei calciatori e calciatrici e ribadisce l’invito alle vittime di violenza o stalking a chiamare il 1522. Secondo quanto riportato da Figc, L’iniziativa è legata alla Giornata internazionale per l’eliminazione della violenza sulle donne. Lo riferisce la FIGC.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

In a recent development, gianluigi Donnarumma, Cristiana Girelli, Laura Giuliani, Pio Esposito, Riccardo Calafiori e Annamaria Serturini sono i protagonisti della comunicazione della Federazione. La campagna affronta la violenza di genere in tutte le sue forme: non soltanto gli episodi di cronaca, ancora troppo frequenti, ma anche la dimensione culturale e sociale del fenomeno, legata agli stereotipi e al mancato riconoscimento della libertà e dell’autonomia delle donne.

According to recent reports, il messaggio distingue la violenza da ciò che può essere presentato come una lite, il controllo dalla gelosia e il possesso dalla protezione: «È una lite? No, è violenza. È gelosia? No, è controllo. È protezione? No, è possesso». A queste domande la campagna affianca una risposta: il numero 1522.

Il 1522 è un servizio gratuito di pubblica utilità istituito nel 2006 dal Dipartimento per le Pari Opportunità. Il suo obiettivo è favorire l’emersione e il contrasto della violenza contro le donne, sia all’interno sia all’esterno della famiglia, attraverso un’ampia azione di sistema.

In occasione della Giornata internazionale, la FIGC torna quindi a invitare le vittime di ogni forma di violenza o stalking a comporre il numero.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By KATE MCGREAVY, EXECUTIVE SPORTS EDITOR.

Published: 04:01 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 05:10 EST, 22 November 2026.

Bruno Fernandes has revealed there are no ongoing contract negotiations with Manchester United after he rejected their proposed new deal.

The Manchester United captain's contract is set to expire in June 2027, which means that if the club and player fail to agree fresh terms, Fernandes will be free to discuss a summer move with clubs abroad as early as the January transfer window.

Fernandes has divided United fans during their dire season so far but upcoming manager Mauricio Pochettino confirmed he will remain as captain in his first press conference on Friday.

It was widely known that discussions between Fernandes and Man United began over the summer, on the heels of a strong campaign which saw him named Men's PFA Player of the Year.

But Fernandes has now shed light on his future by admitting contract talks have stalled after the club put a deal on the table.

According to recent reports, 'No, there's no negotiations ongoing,' Fernandes told Sky Sports ahead of United's trip to Anfield this afternoon. 'But I've seen people saying that he's asked for more money, he's asked for more years. If I wanted more money I wouldn't be here.

Bruno Fernandes has revealed there are no ongoing contract negotiations with Man United.

According to recent reports, 'I had somewhere to go to get much more money than being at Manchester United. I could have been in a place that is much warmer than Manchester. Two summers ago, three summers ago, last summer, I always had a chance to leave and I always chose to be here.

'The thing is I've always showed how much I care about the club and how much I want to win at this club.

Industry observers note that 'And I've always noted the moment the club thinks is the time for me to move on, I will move on. I'm not going to be the player that I've seen many in this time at Man United they're going to stay here just by staying, just by finishing my contract and then we will see.

'In the moment the club says "Bruno, it's time to part ways", I'm going to be the first one walking out the door.

'Yeah the club offered me a new contract so I think that from their side demonstrates that they want me to stay.

Industry observers note that 'As I said there are no negotiations going on. We spoke about the contract at the end of last season. We came in the beginning of the season speaking about the contract but about the context of the team and the club I just put that to a side because I don't think it's the right moment, neither for me, neither for the club to be talking about negotiations because the most important thing now is that the club gets back to winning games.'.

The club may yet seek to trigger the 12-month extension in Fernandes' contract. Daily Mail Sport understands Galatasaray as well as AC Milan and Saudi are among those monitoring developments.

The Portuguese was linked with a big-money move to Saudi Arabia last year with Al-Hilal reportedly willing to offer a contract worth up to £200m to the midfielder, on top of a £100m transfer fee to United, but he chose to commit his future to the Red Devils.

United presently sit in the relegation zone after a 40-year worst-ever start to the season. Fernandes publicly questioned the former manager's tactics after his side's Champions League thrashing at the hands of Como, and has struggled to find form this season.

Fernandes was brought back into the fold after going through a brief period of being frozen out of Michael Carrick's squad following his incendiary comments following defeat in Italy last month.

Fernandes, who is usually very deliberate in what he says in the media, was scathing in his criticism of coaches after the Como debacle.

'It's a decision from the staff to not press man-to-man and sometimes leave a little space in behind and try to get the ball in the first moment, to wait for them, to give them the ball,' he noted.

'But sometimes when you give too much the ball to these teams they get confident, they have so many bodies behind the ball that make you run a lot, make people get frustrated, and then obviously when you recover the ball the legs are, and the brain, much more difficult to make it work.'.

His post-Como interview was widely condemned by fans and pundits alike, with Gary Neville lamenting: 'If that's your captain saying that, imagine what they're saying in the dressing room behind closed doors when no one's listening. That's horrific.'.

He also told Fernandes to 'read the room' and accused him of being an 'excuse merchant' on his podcast.

Fernandes was left on the bench for Man United's next Premier League appointment, a loss to Bournemouth, before returning to the starting XI against Chelsea the following matchday.

After Man United's comeback win against Roma, Fernandes was defiant in his post-match remarks as he stressed that he had not been sanctioned for undermining Carrick with his initial interview.

'The club needed that win. The players needed that win. It is something we needed as a group of players and staff,' he mentioned. 'We have been working so hard to get out of this situation together. It has been tough. There has been a lot of speculation in the media.

Mauricio Pochettino confirmed Fernandes will remain as captain in his first press conference.

It has been revealed that 'A lot of lies around many things that have happened at this club, between me and the manager, like that we have cleared the air. Nothing like that happened.

According to recent reports, 'The manager took a decision of making myself on the bench because I wasn't performing. And that's fair.

'Everyone felt like that was a punishment for the words that I had [after Como]. And if it was, it was right.

'The manager makes the decisions. I have to accept it. I have to go forward with that. It doesn't change the belief I have in the manager, the staff and every player at this club.

'And it doesn't change my aim to win every f***ing game that I have ahead of me.'.

Fernandes' comments were ultimately unable to keep Carrick in his job however, with the former club captain finally sacked on November 11 after an agonising three-day wait.

Man United's hierarchy, notably chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox, have come under fire from the fanbase and within the club for their treatment of the departing coach, with Carrick taking two days of training at Carrington as they mulled his sacking.

Wilcox and Berrada jetted to Monaco to meet with Ineos chief Sir Jim Ratcliffe and discuss the departure of Carrick, with the club's Glazer ownership ratifying the decision to replace him with United States national team coach Pochettino.

Pochettino swapped the USA for United on Wednesday and will take charge of his first match against bitter rivals Liverpool today.

By MATT BARLOW, FOOTBALL WRITER.

Published: 12:22 EST, 21 November 2026 | Updated: 06:34 EST, 22 November 2026.

Luca Williams-Barnett will score better goals. That was the consensus on a day when the Tottenham starlet marked his first Premier League by scoring the first and creating the second.

Roberto De Zerbi compared him to Lamine Yamal after watching the 18-year-old steal the show as Spurs beat Ipswich, their fourth win in five to move within three points of the top four.

'He is a special player, I am not surprised,' remarked De Zerbi. 'I decided 10 days ago he would play and I asked him two things. First, to play like he is on the park with his friends and then to work hard without the ball, like Raphinha and Yamal.

'In football today players with talent have to work hard and attackers are the first defenders.'.

Asked if Williams-Barnett could aspire to the levels of Barcelona’s Yamal, the Spurs boss replied: 'Yes, I think so'. And told how on the teenager had spent the bus ride to the stadium watching clips of Ronaldinho, Neymar and Eden Hazard on YouTube.

His goal was a picture of youthful desire and determination to get across his marker at the back post and be first to a delicious teasing cross delivered by Pedro Porro.

Roberto De Zerbi rates Williams-Barnett as ‘one of the best’ young players he has worked with.

Williams-Barnett slid and stretched past Abdoul Ouattara with his right foot as the ball skipped and hit him high on the left thigh before rebounding into the bottom corner.

In a recent development, you make your own luck. The Spurs crowd erupted. They have been waiting to hail another of their own. Maybe this is the one. A goal on his first start, just like Harry Kane, and at 18 years and 51 days, the club’s youngest league scorer since Gareth Bale.

There has been a buzz growing around Williams-Barnett for the last 18 months as he rose through the academy ranks. He made his England Under-19 debut in September, coming on as a sub for Max Dowman, Arsenal’s teenage sensation.

De Zerbi adores his attitude as much as his talent, and a confidence bordering arrogance on display in pre-season when he dinked in a ‘Panenka’ style penalty in a shootout in Australia.

He is right-footed but started against Ipswich wide on the left, in the role no player has made their own since Heung-min Son.

Dominic Solanke, who scored Tottenham's second goal, congratulates his young team-mate.

Williams-Barnett might have had a second before half time, a half-chance miscued and a header saved.

According to recent reports, spurs fans responded. When he picked up the ball on halfway early in the second half, they roared him forward into the space ahead. He duly obliged, through the gears into a swagger and into the Ipswich penalty box without meeting a challenge.

Tottenham (4-2-3-1): Kinsky 6; Porro 7, Van Hecke 6, Senesi 6, Udogie 6 (Robertson 80); Fernandes 7, Gallagher 7; Kudus 6, Maddison 7 (Bergvall 64, 5), Williams-Barnett 8 (Savio 64, 6 (Gray 90)); Solanke 7 (Marmoush 64, 5).

Scorers: Williams-Barnett, Solanke.

Booked: Maddison, Williams-Barnett, Kudus, Fernandes.

Ipswich (3-4-2-1): Walton 7; Furlong 5, Diop 5, O’Shea 6; Outtara 4 (Fatawu 56, 5), Palacios 5 (Florentino 56, 5), Lukic 6, Davis 6 (Greaves 82); Enciso 5, Maeda 5 (Clarke 56, 5); Flemming 6.

Belatedly, Darnell Furlong tried to hold him up. But Williams-Barnett made a yard on the outside and whipped over a cross with his left foot, which fizzed past Walton and was turned in from close range by Dominic Solanke.

The teenager booted the ball jubilantly into the crowd and collected his first yellow card from killjoy referee Rob Jones.

It has been revealed that williams-Barnett left to a standing ovation when he was replaced by Savio in the 64th minute. 'Luca was magnificent,' mentioned Solanke. 'To see him do that on his first Premier League start is crazy.'.

Spurs coasted in. It had been comfortable, even without some senior players including Sandro Tonali who had been unwell.

In a recent development, they were solid at the back and creative up front, peppering the Ipswich goal with 18 shots. Mohamed Kudus struck a post from a first-half free kick, won by Williams-Barnett.

Christian Walton made strong saves to deny James Maddison and prevent Dara O’Shea turning into his own goal.

Sources indicate that savio cross hit a post with a deflected cross before he was struck down by a recurrence of the hamstring injury which ruled him out for six weeks. It was the only blemish for De Zerbi, although one to enhance the opportunities ahead for Williams-Barnett.

Thomas Tuchel faces a fight to regain the full trust of his England players, despite claiming that “99.9 per cent” of supporters do not talk about the semi-final defeat by Argentina.

Telegraph Sport reported that players were shocked and disappointed by Tuchel’s approach to the final 30 minutes of the World Cup semi-final.

It can now be revealed that doubts linger among England players over Tuchel’s ability to get the best out of his squad and ultimately lead them to glory in the next European Championship.

There is also some lasting unhappiness over Tuchel’s perceived unwillingness to take ultimate responsibility for England’s World Cup exit and his claim that ball possession was not in “the DNA” of the nation’s players.

Sources indicate that tuchel has spoken of fostering a “brotherhood” within the England squad, but a source told Telegraph Sport: “He still has work to do to get all the players fully behind him again. What happened at the World Cup and some of his comments caused some damage that has not just disappeared.”.

Tuchel has no concerns over the commitment of his players and said: “I have no doubt how keen they are. No doubt. I know them, I was seven weeks with them. We had a qualification campaign together, we are 18 months together, I have no doubt that we step up and produce performances in the next cycle. I’m responsible for that.”.

According to recent reports, one player who did not travel to the World Cup and is not part of Tuchel’s latest England squad for four Nations League games is Morgan Gibbs-White. His partner, Britney De Villiers, took a swipe at Tuchel by posting an image on Instagram that referenced the fact the Nottingham Forest man is the only Premier League player to have created five or more chances in every match he has played this season.

There is no immediate sign that Tuchel is ready to change his approach, as he refused to accept the country were angered by his tactics and substitutions in the Argentina game.

In an attempt to gloss over the nature of England’s missed opportunity in the United States, Tuchel claimed that the bronze-medal victory over France was “one of the nicest experiences ever” for supporters and that he did not lose any sleep over his World Cup squad selection.

Tuchel’s defence of the World Cup campaign also included the revelation that his Football Association bosses had assured the England head coach that his job was safe before the last-16 victory over Mexico.

Recent findings suggest that “I tell you something, like 99.9 per cent of the fans don’t speak about substitutions, tactical twists,” Tuchel said. “They speak about where they have watched the Mexico game, they speak about the second half, the energy of the Croatia match, they speak about how nerve-wracking it was to watch our match against Congo and where they celebrated.

It has been revealed that “This is how it should be, this is what a World Cup is for, to connect with the people and to give them experiences that they will not forget. And this is the feedback that I get.”.

Asked if he had received any negative feedback at all since the World Cup, Tuchel answered: “No. Not at all. Do you think that’s necessary? I had some quite bad stuff between Argentina and France. [But] No [not since I’ve been back in England].”.

The FA publicly backed Tuchel after the defeat by Argentina, but the German has now revealed that he was privately told his job was safe well before that.

According to recent reports, even if England had lost to Mexico and failed to reach the last eight of the World Cup, Tuchel has claimed he would not have been sacked. He said: “There was a moment, a very special moment, before the Mexico game where we had a talk and my bosses told me ‘we know that anything can happen in a football match, we know that anything can happen in a match in Mexico, in a World Cup match, but don’t worry, we see what’s going on and we want to continue like this’.

Recent findings suggest that “It was a beautiful moment for me as a coach. I felt this kind of freedom to take my choices and to just coach freely, and there was never a doubt in my mind that we would continue together and there was obviously never a doubt in their mind.”.

England secured their best World Cup finish since 1966 by winning the bronze-medal game against France in a chaotic match in Miami.

It has been revealed that “If you look at the 6-4 against France, people talk about it like it’s one of their nicest experiences ever, to watch a football match,” Tuchel said. “So maybe I have to compromise in my wish for control, for a little bit more chaos, embrace the chaos, and maybe it brings out the best.”.

Tuchel has named his first England squad since the World Cup for four Nations League games against Spain, Czech Republic (home and away) and Croatia. He has recalled Cole Palmer and Trent Alexander-Arnold to his squad, but insists he has lost no sleep over not taking the pair to the World Cup.

Sources indicate that “I was very happy with the [World Cup] squad selection, we put a lot of effort and emphasis into the squad selection,” Tuchel remarked. “And I had a lot of sleepless nights, but I had not one sleepless night about our selection, because I was more than seven weeks with this group of players, and they were nothing but fantastic. I think the spirit that we built and the mentality that we showed brought us to the place that we got.

“It feels unfulfilled, but, yeah, that’s how it is. We need to move forward with the decisions in the Argentina game. And sometimes as a coach, you can only win if you win. So now we know the result, and we didn’t win. Of course, I reflect and, of course, I’m very critical of myself. But the question that is also still lingering around is, who knows what would have happened? Who knows if we hadn’t made any substitutions what would have happened? And would we have the same sleepless nights?

In a recent development, “So, there’s not much sense in torturing ourselves, looking back. It’s moving forward, but the team, like I remarked, did brilliantly. And I will not allow 30 minutes against Argentina to override how we view this World Cup.”.

Recent findings suggest that tuchel had warnings for Palmer and Alexander-Arnold, as he remarked: “It is one thing to be nominated, by the way, with Cole and getting your ticket back in the squad, but it’s another thing to play and keep your place. It’s about when he comes and he needs to show these kinds of performances.”.

On Alexander-Arnold, Tuchel added: “Now it’s time to fight for his place. He always said he’s up for a fight, especially for England. So it’s a need to prove that.”.

Tuchel said that Alexander-Arnold has been called up as a right-back, rather than a midfielder. Asked if the Real Madrid player offers enough defensively, he answered by saying: “He has to, he has to. It’s necessary. My conviction is that he will, but he has no choice.”.

Tuchel has now finished his broadcast duties. It was quite a strange performance from him. I don’t recall ever seeing him read from notes before. His little joke about his bosses telling him off was awkward and felt rehearsed, and the stuff about 99.9 per cent of England fans talking about Mexico and the second half against Croatia was delusional.

It was also jarring to hear him claim that the FA had basically assured Tuchel that his job was safe straight after England beat Mexico. It was a special night, undoubtedly, but did it really deserve that sort of reaction?

“I don’t have a clear picture on what he is all about and have a very clear picture on what Levi can bring us.”.

Il presidente dell'Inter, Giuseppe Marotta, ha scoperto il vaso di Pandora e ammesso che il bomber del Monza sia di gradimento non solo in casa nerazzurra: "Varela è un giocatore che non piace solo all'Inter, ma a tante squadre. Normale che, vista la vicinanza con Monza, il mio direttore sportivo vada a vedere queste partite. Varela è una sorpresa molto bella per la Serie A". D'altronde l'attaccante portoghese alla sua prima stagione in Serie A sta raggiungendo numeri paurosi, con 13 gol in 12 partite disputate con la maglia del Monza tra tutte le competizioni. Secondo solo a Malen (Roma) per quota reti in campionato.

Dopo poco più di tre mesi di lavoro al Milan, molti si domandano se Ruben Amorim possa correre per lo Scudetto insieme a Inter, Roma e Lazio quest'anno, ma il tecnico portoghese - alla vigilia del match di Europa League contro l'Olympiacos - è rimasto fedele a quanto dichiarato anzitempo: "Non ho cambiato idea. Quest'anno è difficile, ma se abbiamo la possibilità di lottare lo faremo. Non cambierò per i complimenti, perché aspetto ed anche voi state aspettando (le critiche, ndr). Domani dobbiamo vincere, perché se non lo facessimo... sono pronto per questo".

Il Como ha depositato il progetto per il nuovo stadio lo scorso 13 novembre. Secondo quanto riferito da La Provincia di Como, questo dovrà essere ora esaminato dagli uffici comunali competenti. L'annuncio è arrivato durante una seduta del Consiglio comunale, il capogruppo di Svolta Civica Vittorio Nessi in merito alla discussione portata avanti sul "Sinigaglia", ha chiesto aggiornamenti al sindaco Alessandro Rapinese dei tempi e dello stato di fatto sulla questione stadio. "Appena gli uffici mi daranno la pratica, quella mattina farò colazione un po’ più in fretta, convocherò un po’ prima la giunta, e via, lo stadio è fatto e sarà per sempre", ha detto il primo cittadino lariano. A quel punto Nessi ha svelato: "La pratica è stata protocollata il 13 novembre e il fatto che il sindaco faccia apparentemente finta di non sapere dovendo rispondere a un’interrogazione non depone a suo favore".

By JAKE FENNER, US SPORTS WRITER.

Published: 09:15 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 09:15 EST, 22 November 2026.

Kansas City Current co-owner Brittany Mahomes led the celebrations as the women's soccer club won its first ever NWSL Championship on Saturday.

Brittany, the wife of Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes, was at Audi Field in Washington, DC for the final match of the season between the Current and the Washington Spirit.

A thrilling finish to the contest resulted in a 2-1 win for the Current, who have only been in existence for five years.

Brittany, who is pregnant with her fourth child, was seen on the pitch celebrating after her team's inaugural title.

She was seen embracing her team and her co-owners as they jumped up and down in celebration of the achievement.

Brittany was a part of the inaugural ownership group of the club when it was announced as an expansion team in 2020.

KC Current co-owner Brittany Mahomes celebrated her team winning the NWSL title.

She was seen jumping up and down and celebrating with the players as the title was clinched.

It's the first championship for the expansion club, which began playing in 2021.

Brittany's husband, Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes, also celebrated the achievement on social media.

The three-time Super Bowl champion reshared the club's announcement on X, adding, 'AHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!' He later added, 'LETS GOOOO!!!!!!' and a string of light blue hearts.

Kansas City went ahead in the match in the 54th minute with an 'Olimpico' goal from Vanessa DiBernardo, who watched her corner kick curl to the opposite post to break a first-half deadlock.

With Washington pressing late in added time, the Current were able to score on a counter attack goal from the foot of Brazilian star Debinha to make it 2-0.

Mere seconds later, Washington's Trinity Rodman scored a goal of her own to briefly give Spirit fans hope of a miraculous comeback.

But after 11 elapsed minutes - well beyond the nine given, thanks in part to a scary collision between Rodman and KC keeper Laney Rouse - the final whistle blew as Kansas City clinched the title.

The win for the Current means yet another season of heartbreak for Washington, who have made the last three straight NWSL Championship games and have lost all three.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, A Roma, il capitano della Lazio incontra gli alunni della scuola primaria Pistelli vincitrice del contest nazionale “AttiviAMOci tutti i giorni in movimento”. Tra gioco, movimento e storie personali, un messaggio: nello sport, come nella vita, la ver.

Industry observers note that ROMA – Gol al novantesimo o weekend senza compiti? Derby vinto o 10 in matematica? Questa volta la sfida si gioca tra i banchi di scuola e a scendere in campo è Mattia Zaccagni. Il capitano della Lazio incontra i bambini della Scuola Primaria Pistelli di Roma per una partita speciale a colpi di “Questo o quello?”, tra domande a sorpresa, risposte istintive e qualche scelta davvero difficile.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

L’appuntamento fa parte del percorso nazionale promosso da Sport e Salute e adidas per contrastare il drop-out sportivo e tenere viva, fin dai primi anni, la voglia di fare sport. E la Pistelli non è una scuola qualsiasi: istituto aderente a Scuola Attiva Kids, è stata protagonista del contest nazionale “AttiviAMOci tutti i giorni in movimento”, conquistando il primo posto grazie al percorso realizzato per promuovere il movimento come parte integrante della quotidianità scolastica. Una comunità che ha scelto di fare dello sport un’abitudine, un’opportunità e un’esperienza da condividere.

In a recent development, È proprio da questa energia che prende vita l’incontro con Zaccagni. I bambini diventano arbitri delle scelte, mentre il campione si mette alla prova: gol decisivo o vacanza più lunga? Una partita vinta o un bel voto a scuola? Ma dietro le risate e le risposte più divertenti c’è anche spazio per qualcosa di più profondo. Perché lo sport non è soltanto il momento della vittoria: è imparare a gestire una sconfitta, superare un errore, affrontare una difficoltà e trovare ogni volta la voglia di ripartire.

«Nel calcio, come nella vita, ci sono momenti in cui le cose non vanno come vorresti. Puoi sbagliare un gol, perdere una partita o attraversare un periodo complicato. Ma è proprio in quei momenti che devi trovare la forza di rialzarti, continuare a lavorare e credere nelle tue capacità. Io ho imparato che non si cresce soltanto quando si vince, ma soprattutto quando si riesce a reagire alle difficoltà. Ai ragazzi dico di divertirsi, di non avere paura di sbagliare e di non mollare mai quello che li fa stare bene. Perché nello sport, prima ancora dei risultati, conta la voglia di continuare a giocare», racconta Mattia Zaccagni ai bambini.

Dalle parole si passa al movimento. Con i tutor di Sport e Salute, gli alunni partecipano a una lezione di attività motoria, tra giochi, prove di abilità e lavoro di squadra. Tutti protagonisti, ciascuno con le proprie capacità, in un’esperienza che mette al centro il piacere di muoversi e stare insieme.

It has been revealed that È questa la sfida che Sport e Salute e adidas vogliono vincere: contrastare l’abbandono sportivo, offrendo ai più giovani occasioni per scoprire una passione, sentirsi parte di una squadra e trovare nello sport uno spazio in cui crescere. Perché nessuno dovrebbe smettere di giocare solo perché non è il più bravo, perché ha incontrato una difficoltà o perché una partita è andata male.

La Pistelli, con il suo percorso premiato a livello nazionale, dimostra che questa partita può iniziare proprio dalla scuola. E che il risultato più importante non è segnare un gol in più, ma fare in modo che domani ci siano ancora tanti bambini pronti a scendere in campo.

In vista della gara di domani contro il Milan, Imanol Alguaciln, allenatore dell'Olympiacos, ha parlato così della partita contro la squadra rossonera:.

Ha intenzione di cambiare il piano di gioco per la partita contro il Milan? "Ho riflettuto su cosa posso fare per aiutare la squadra, come del resto faccio in ogni partita. Sono un allenatore che non ha paura di cambiare modulo e di adattarsi alle esigenze del momento o dell'avversario, anche se mi piace che la squadra giochi secondo una determinata filosofia. Mi sono venute in mente diverse soluzioni e abbiamo preparato alcune cose. Sicuramente non ho alcun dubbio su quello che faremo".

Recent findings suggest that può dirci quale giocatore intende schierare accanto a Freuler oppure preferisce non rispondere? "Retsos, Sá, Toufakis, Filis: scegliete voi chi volete. Uno di loro giocherà in quella posizione. L'ho già detto in precedenza: non possiamo cercare alcun tipo di alibi. Dobbiamo scegliere tra i giocatori che abbiamo a disposizione e fare le scelte giuste per essere competitivi. Affrontiamo un avversario forte e una grandissima squadra come il Milan che, nonostante abbia attualmente tre punti, è una candidata alla vittoria dell'Europa League e del campionato italiano. La rispettiamo, ma noi siamo l'Olympiacos, abbiamo le nostre ambizioni, il pubblico dalla nostra parte e giochiamo in casa. Chiunque sia disponibile in questo momento dovrà dare il proprio contributo per permetterci di essere competitivi contro il Milan".

Recent findings suggest that L'allenatore avversario ha definito questa partita una questione di vita o di morte. Quale titolo darebbe lei a questa partita? "Lo stesso. Sono d'accordo con la definizione: vita o di morte".

Recent findings suggest that È contento che Modrić non sarà presente alla partita? Lo ha affrontato molte volte nel corso della sua carriera. "Sì, l'ho affrontato molte volte nel corso della mia carriera. È un calciatore molto importante e dà un contributo a qualsiasi squadra in cui giochi. Ho affrontato diverse versioni di Modrić e mi dispiace che i tifosi che verranno allo stadio non possano vederlo e godersi le sue giocate. Sicuramente si tratta di un'assenza importante per la sua squadra".

Sources indicate that L'Olympiacos è il club più grande della Grecia e gioca sempre per vincere. Il Milan ha conquistato sette Champions League. In queste condizioni il pareggio sarebbe un buon risultato oppure l'Olympiacos punta esclusivamente alla vittoria? "Noi giochiamo sempre per vincere. Non iniziamo mai una partita pensando di non doverla vincere. Dopo la partita potremo dirvi se un pareggio sarà stato un buon risultato per noi. Questo dipenderà da come si sarà sviluppato l'incontro. Come ho detto all'inizio, anche se attualmente il Milan ha tre punti, rimane una grande squadra e la rispettiamo assolutamente. Per noi è una delle favorite per la vittoria dell'Europa League. Noi partiamo con l'obiettivo di vincere. Siamo l'Olympiacos, giochiamo in casa e non c'è nulla che possa farci cambiare questa mentalità. Soltanto dopo la partita potrò dirvi qualcosa sul risultato".

Napoli star Scott McTominay and his girlfriend Cam Reading have unveiled they're expecting their first child together.

The couple shared a joint post on Instagram with one picture of them holding up an ultrasound image, another of Reading reclining in a bikini and a third of the pregnancy test itself.

They revealed the news on the same day McTominay broke Napoli's three-game losing streak, scoring the winner in a 1-0 victory over Torino.

The couple wrote: 'The most precious gift, a lifetime of love.' McTominay, 29, and Reading have settled into life in Italy after he joined from Man United and revived his career, winning the Scudetto and earning Player of the Year honours.

It remains to be seen whether the baby will be born in Italy or back in the UK but the couple were overjoyed at sharing their happy news.

It is not exactly clear when McTominay and Reading first crossed paths but they have at least been together since the summer of 2023, when they were pictured on a boat trip in Greece.

Cam Reading and Scott McTominay shared the news that they're expecting a baby.

Reading posted this picture of her bump on her Instagram page and wrote of a 'precious gift'.

Reading, a director at asset management firm Fortress Capital partners, has seen her personal celebrity skyrocket in that time, zooming up from 10,000 Instagram followers to over 90,000.

According to La Repubblica, they have moved into a house by Lago Patria, a coastal lake near the suburb of Giugliano.

There, McTominay can be by the seaside quickly after popping out of his door and is only around a 20-minute drive from Napoli's training centre.

The couple regularly share photos from their newly introduced life together in Italy and McTominay is adored by fans having repeatedly delivered in big moments, none more so than on the final day of the 2024-25 season when an acrobatic strike put Napoli ahead as they clinched the title over Inter Milan.

This season has been less straightforward for McTominay. The Scotland international underwent heart surgery after being diagnosed with 'a mild benign arrhythmia', which is an abnormal or irregular heart rhythm deemed non-serious and posing no significant risk to overall health.

Before the surgery, the British Heart Foundation explained that the procedure McTominay was having would see heat or cold energy used to create tiny scars in the heart to block faulty signals and restore a typical heartbeat.

The procedure took place at the start of September in Manchester, and he was initially supposed to be on the sidelines for two weeks before returning to training.

But he was ruled out of Scotland action during the international break and is now back on the grass with Napoli, scoring the winner against Torino on Saturday.

McTominay and Reading also posted this snap of the ultrasound and positive test.

The midfielder scored the winner on Saturday for Napoli against Torino.

He has now scored 33 goals in 92 matches across all competitions with the Partenopei and remains one of Serie A's leading lights.

The Italian press gushed over his contribution on Saturday, with Corriere dello Sport writing: 'He played with fire in his belly.

'Three shots in the opening 16 minutes; seven in total—three on target— and a decisive goal (his fourth against Torino, his favourite Serie A opponent, along with Inter), plus the charisma of a leader.'.

Bloodthirsty Brighton feast on rattled Arsenal

📅 19 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 23 min read (4650 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~23 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Overpowered and overrun, Arsenal were subjected to the sort of gruelling treatment they usually inflict on their opponents.
  • It has been revealed that in the biggest test of their season so far, Arsenal fell woefully short of the standards they have set themselves over the past few campaigns.
  • Sources indicate that brighton were everything that Arsenal are expected to be: aggressive, inventive and dominant across the field.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Overpowered and overrun, Arsenal were subjected to the sort of gruelling treatment they usually inflict on their opponents. Mikel Arteta’s side did not look anything like Premier League champions here, as Brighton and Hove Albion produced a stunning performance full of swarming energy and breathless bravery.

It has been revealed that in the biggest test of their season so far, Arsenal fell woefully short of the standards they have set themselves over the past few campaigns. This sort of thing simply does not happen to Arteta’s side. Well, it did not happen. Not before this monstering on the south coast, where the Brighton fans were whipped into a frenzy by the brilliance of Fabian Hürzeler’s players.

Sources indicate that brighton were everything that Arsenal are expected to be: aggressive, inventive and dominant across the field. They even scored with a set-piece, as one of Arsenal’s great strengths became a sudden weakness. Everywhere Arteta looked, the foundational truths of his team were being shaken by a Brighton storm. It was their first defeat by a three-goal margin since May 2023, also against Brighton.

Remarkably, this is now the third consecutive season in which Brighton have beaten the reigning Premier League champions. They are rarely happier than when they are on the hunt against more illustrious opponents, working as a team to snap at heels and then attacking in numbers. They are known as the Seagulls, but they played more like a pack of bloodthirsty wolves. The ferocity of their off-the-ball work, especially in the first half, was extraordinary.

Sources indicate that not for a long time have Arsenal been as rattled as they were here. David Raya misplaced passes, Gabriel Magalhães lost duels and Bruno Guimarães chased the ball in vain. It was Brighton’s Pascal Gross, rather than Arsenal’s Martin Odegaard, who shaped the game in midfield. It was Brighton’s Charalampos Kostoulas, rather than Arsenal’s Kai Havertz, who offered incisive class in attack.

Sources indicate that gross and Kostoulas both struck from range in a one-sided first half, before Chema Andrés added the third after the break. At half-time, Arteta had sprinted down the tunnel towards the dressing room. Whatever messages he gave to his players, they either did not sink in or did not work. By the end, Arsenal were lucky the scoreline was not even more humiliating.

In a recent development, arteta’s players had come through some tricky assignments in winning their first seven matches of this season, but this was their toughest test yet and they failed it badly. They did not handle the emotions of the occasion particularly well, either: in stoppage time, a frustrated Declan Rice kicked out at Malick Yalcouyé. He was perhaps fortunate to avoid a red card.

It was the first time that Rice and Guimarães had started alongside each other for Arsenal and it promptly became clear that their £180m partnership will need some work. Arsenal would have hoped their experience in the Premier League would allow for an instant connection but, evidently, that is not the case. Guimarães was hooked after 60 minutes, but might easily have been removed at the break.

Both managers had a similar assessment of the match and how it was won: Brighton did the basics far better than Arsenal. “How we wanted to approach this game was getting into it through small wins,” Hürzeler stated. “Everyone speaks about a goal or chance as a win, but a small win can be the first throw-in, the first corner, win the first header, win the first tackle. These small things. If you win these small steps, and celebrate them as a win, then you can gain bigger and bigger wins.”.

Recent findings suggest that it was typical of Brighton that one of their upcoming signings produced an excellent performance in midfield. Andrés, a 21-year-old Spaniard signed from Stuttgart at the end of the transfer window, looks to be the latest gem identified by their data-led recruitment model. No one inside the Amex Stadium was thinking about Carlos Baleba, sold to Manchester United, when Andrés made his tackles and won his headers.

Recent findings suggest that another latest signing, centre-back Luka Vuskovic, was similarly impressive at the back. Signed for £46m from Tottenham Hotspur, Vuskovic looks more than capable of going to the top of the game.

According to recent reports, this was perhaps the first occasion this season in which Arsenal missed William Saliba, the injured centre-back who has been so fundamental to their success in recent years. The Frenchman can always be relied on to provide calmness and composure at the back, even under intense pressure. Without him, Arsenal were uncharacteristically jittery.

“The amount of technical errors we did in our own half...” Arteta bemoaned. “We didn’t respect any principle of play that you have to get out of those man-to-man situations. That put us always on the back foot.”.

In a recent development, gross, who at 35 is playing as well as ever, opened the scoring with a low shot from range after 31 minutes. Kostoulas then struck the second, from a similar distance, after some end-to-end action resulted in Arsenal’s midfield and defence melting away. The third was the most simple, as Andrés headed in at the back post from an inswinging corner.

Sources indicate that arsenal did have some chances, with Havertz missing the best of them, but there was never a sense that Brighton were vulnerable. The pressure on the home side was never sustained. For Arteta, who now has an extended international break in which to ruminate on this defeat, it all made for an unfamiliar and unexpected pain.

Mikel Arteta mentioned his Arsenal players failed to “respect the game” as their perfect start to the season was ended in stunning style by a brilliant Brighton performance.

Arsenal’s capitulation on the south coast led to their first defeat of the campaign and Arteta admitted that Brighton had a different “edge” and “bite” throughout the match. The Arsenal manager also stated the 3-0 loss represented a “big lesson” for his players.

Recent findings suggest that “There are certain basics you need to accomplish in football, especially in the Premier League, that we were very far from,” Arteta remarked. “From the first throw-in you could sense it, it was so clear.

“It was a really disappointing result and performance. Brighton were another gear up from us. We were extremely poor technically and were not respecting the game.

Recent findings suggest that “It is not going to take away what the team has done in the last six or seven weeks since coming back from the World Cup. What we have done and the way we have competed, and the amount of games we have won, has been remarkable. But this is a massive lesson for all of us to understand what it takes to win at this level.”.

Arteta added that his team did not “respect the principles of play” that were required against Brighton’s intense pressing, and also said his players were guilty of numerous technical errors.

It has been revealed that “Credit to Brighton for what they have done because they have overcome us and they had another edge,” Arteta stated. “There are a lot of moments when the ball is 50/50 and it changes hands and most of the time it was for them.”.

Brighton are the Premier League’s top scorers this season with 16 goals in five matches so far, and this emphatic victory took them up to third place in the table.

Recent findings suggest that “It was a special win,” Fabian Hürzeler, the Brighton head coach, mentioned. “Not only because we played the best team in England but because of the performance. I am really proud of my team. It’s always crucial to enjoy these moments. We were horrible to play against. My players really trust each other on the pitch.”.

Two things, one give credit to them. In the manner that they played and committed to every single action. We were below the standards that are required for us but in the Premier League as well.

In a recent development, when you miss chances like we did it becomes impossible. I want to congratulate Brighton for what they’ve done. It’s a big lesson for us to learn. If I have to describe how the team has played and competed in the last six or seven weeks, has been expectational but today has been a big lesson.

A very disappointing result and performance. Full credit to Brighton the manner they went about the game, they were a different gear from us. We didn’t do the basics right for long periods, especially in the first half. We didn’t win enough duels, and any second balls and that stretches you.

We were poor technically when we had the ball in our own half, we didn’t apply the principles that you need against a team that wants to press you man to man.

It has been revealed that arteta: "There are certain basics that you need to accomplish in the Premier League that we were very far from. The amount of technical errors we did... we didn't respect any principle of play. We were always on the back foot. They had another edge.".

Beating the current champions and maybe the best team in England is something special. The result is nice but the performance is what makes it special, the boys highlighted real courage, real intensity and they were horrible to play against because we did the basics right.

In a recent development, intensity, intensity, winning the personal duels...we have to have the belief to compete with the best teams in the league. My players really trust each other on the pitch. If one player is out then another can replace him.

Overall we wanted to be really good in every phase. We needed to be at the highest level. We go game by game. After the international break we have a lot of games. After wins like this we have to stay humble and understand why we had this win. We have to keep on going.

According to recent reports, I thought we revealed great intensity, waited for mistakes and punished Arsenal. It was a strong performance, a very complete performance.

We won the ball high up and attacked really fast. After the last two wins we are full of confidence and wanted to finish really strong before the international break.

In a recent development, I feel really good. I can’t complain. I just try to help the team when I can. I really enjoy life in Brighton, I’m loving it.

Recent findings suggest that I know after the international break we play every three days and a lot of the lads are not used to that. It will be tough. I hope we can compete. We have a substantial squad this season.

Brighton have beaten the reigning Premier League champions in three consecutive seasons.

Like Everton, Newcastle labour to a home win which should have been more comfortable. It would have been had Wissa scored his penalty, but it was a nervy finish as Hull pushed for an equaliser after Cho’s goal.

Everton up to fifth but they made hard work of that against Ipswich’s 10 men, but Thierno Barry’s goal proves the difference. Barry unfortunate that his second did not stand because of a contentious offside check.

Sources indicate that one of the outstanding team performances of the season so far from Brighton, and it will take some beating between now and May. Arsenal were loose defensively in open play and from set-pieces, and were smothered by Brighton’s pressing. Arteta’s team beaten for the first time this season and emphatically so. Arsenal’s first defeat by a three-goal margin since May 2023.

Just three minutes of stoppage time remaining, but Hull are still pushing bodies forward.

Hull are knocking on the door at St James’ Park, and Newcastle are hanging on to their lead rather than pressing for a third goal.

According to recent reports, matt O’Riley has missed two great chances to make it four. Brighton have not given Arsenal a sniff. It will be interesting to hear how stern Arteta is in his post-match assessment.

Recent findings suggest that kai Havertz shoots straight at the goalkeeper when clean through, and that is surely Arsenal’s last chance of an unlikely comeback gone. Brighton have pushed Arsenal back for much of the season half, they have not been sitting on a lead.

At St James’ Park, Hull have pulled a goal back through Cho to set up a nervy finish for Newcastle.

The forward is shown a second yellow card for diving, and Ipswich’s hopes appear to be dwindling at the Hill Dickinson Stadium.

According to recent reports, what a farcical five minutes we have had, from an absurd disallowed goal for Everton to a ridiculous red card for Abdul Fatawu, banished for a second bookable offence - which was diving. It has been revealed that as half-time approaches, Arsenal have mustered just one shot on goal worth 0.03 expected goals. When they have moved the ball beyond Brighton’s press, they have not done anywhere near enough with it.

Sources indicate that this fixture last season was especially bad-tempered, with the Brighton fans (and manager) repeatedly accusing Arsenal of time-wasting. The memories of that defeat are clearly still fresh in the minds of the Brighton supporters, who are roaring with rage at every perceived delay by the visitors, despite the fact that Arsenal are losing. The bad blood is adding to the intensity of the occasion.

Ipswich don’t play like a team that is short of confidence and quality. You might assume, if you haven’t seen much of them, that they are destined for a season of toil but there is definite quality with Gary O’Neill’s ranks, including Abdul Fatawu, who has been magnetic in drawing your eye to him. They might be a goal down but they are playing as if they are a goal in front.

Arsenal had just enjoyed a spell of control, but trail to a goal from one of the league’s in-form players. Gross whips a shot from just outside the box around Raya and in off the post.

In a recent development, brighton have the lead at the Amex and it’s their captain, Pascal Gross, who has provided it. Superb long-range effort, in off the near post. On the overall balance of play, Brighton deserve that. It’s reward for their courage and willingness to go after Arsenal, rather than sitting back.

It took almost 20 minutes but Arsenal have found their feet in this game now. They are starting to find avenues through Brighton’s aggressive pressing and have made a few promising runs in behind, through Havertz and Saka. This is a high quality match.

No goals at the Amex, but Brighton are the team making the running, Arsenal struggling to play out from their own half and are yet to register a shot on goal.

Industry observers note that bright start from Everton and they have the goal they deserve, albeit it came in fortuitous circumstances. Barry now has five goals for the season and, while he is raw, it’s an invaluable contribution.

In a recent development, A storming response to a bad night at Leeds from Newcastle, and it looks like being a long afternoon for Hull. Two down in seven minutes.

What a start for Newcastle United and what will really please manager Matthias Jaissle is the way both goals have come from his players winning crucial tackles.

The German was incensed by the lack of physicality and intensity in the heavy defeat to Leeds on Monday but the first goal for Joe Wilock came when Lewis Miley won a tackle on the edge of the Hull penalty box.

The second came when Sven Botman came away with the ball just inside his own half. On both occasions Harvey Barnes provided the assist. A short, intricate pass to Willock inside the box and then a surging, twisting run from the halfway line and the perfectly timed pass to Lewis Hall who stroked a first time shot into the bottom corner.

Hull have been outfought so far which is precisely the response Newcastle’s manager had demanded.

Brighton have started brilliantly against the champions. They are hunting like wolves, pressing Arsenal with remarkable intensity. We have played seven minutes and I don’t think the ball has left Arsenal’s half.

The perfect start for Newcastle with all their injuries: Joe Willock has put the home side in a strong position against Hull with a clean strike inside three minutes.

For some of us of a certain age, vertical football just seems like clever upcoming terminology to describe an old idea.

The right back was due to start for Newcastle against Hull City this afternoon – his first start since April – but has picked up another injury.

That will surely mean he is out of the England squad for the Nations League having also picked up a tournament-ending injury at the World Cup in the summer before the first group game.

Livramento only played 17 Premier League games for Newcastle last season, scuppering his chances of a summer move to Arsenal, missing huge chunks of the season with groin and hamstring problems.

Injuries are already cutting deep into the Newcastle squad, with four teenagers on the bench for the visit of Hull. None have played in the first team before and three of them – Michael Mills, Mason Miley and Kyrian Thompson are just 17–years-old.

Good afternoon and welcome to our live coverage of today’s Premier League 3pm kick-offs, with Brighton vs Arsenal the pick of the three matches.

It has been revealed that brighton are the league’s top goalscorers so far this season and have amassed the most expected goals, but the champions have the league’s best defence and are seeking five wins from five to start their title defence. There is some welcome needle between Fabian Hurzeler and Mikel Arteta, dating back to Declan Rice’s contentious second yellow for delaying the restart two years ago, as well as the Brighton manager’s comments about Arsenal’s style of play in March.

That 1-0 Arsenal victory at the Amex coincided with Man City dropping points at home to Nottingham Forest on a pivotal night in the title race. Bukayo Saka scored a deflected shot in the ninth minute, and Arsenal held on from there in an ugly but resolute display.

With Saka, Martin Odegaard and Kai Havertz fit and firing, as well as the introduction of Myles Lewis-Skelly and Bruno Guimaraes to Arteta’s midfield stable, Arsenal’s football has been more technical and enterprising so far this season. Brighton are one of the few teams who will back themselves to play through Arsenal’s press, which should make for an absorbing game.

Elsewhere, Newcastle are looking to bounce back from their shellacking at Leeds at home to surprise package Hull City. Mattias Jaissle’s team took four points from Liverpool and Spurs but there is concern about how many shots they are conceding. Hull remain unbeaten and continue to confound the odds and underlying data, but that surely cannot last forever.

Everton are also one of the division’s unbeaten teams, but will be targeting three points from a home game against Ipswich after three consecutive draws. Ipswich are sitting comfortably on six points after their win at Crystal Palace, though they did have the extra man for the majority at Selhurst Park.

Le dichiarazioni dell'ex team manager della Lazio sul cammino in campionato.

Compleanno dolce per Maurizio Manzini, storico team manager della Lazio, intervenuto a Radiosei durante ‘NMM‘  per commentare il momento positivo dei biancocelesti.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

It has been revealed that questo mio compleanno lo festeggio in un momento piacevole dal punto di vista sportivo. È orgoglio vedere la Lazio lì in classifica, grazie al lavoro di Rino e della squadra. È un grande merito loro ed una grande soddisfazione per noi. Come andrà a finire la stagione? Non lo dico per scaramanzia, diciamo che speriamo di salvarci.

It has been revealed that il legame tra Maurizio Manzini e il club capitolino nasce da lontano, già nel 1971, quando da dirigente nel settore dell'aviazione iniziò a supportare volontariamente la società nella gestione logistica e delle trasferte, conquistando la stima di figure leggendarie come Tommaso Maestrelli. Dopo un primo rifiuto, nella stagione 1988/89 accettò ufficialmente l'incarico di team manager, diventando per decenni l'anello di congiunzione indispensabile tra spogliatoio e vertici societari. Poliglotta, apprezzato da arbitri, colleghi e persino dagli avversari per stile e riservatezza, ha rappresentato la memoria storica del club fino al graduale passaggio di consegne avvenuto a partire dall'annata 2014/15.

Dopo la seconda della stagione - ormai abbondantemente archiviata -, ecco che la Serie B ha affrontato anche il secondo turno infrasettimanale del campionato, con la 13ª giornata che si è giocata tra ieri e oggi.

In a recent development, le tre gare delle ore 20:00 hanno sancito la chiusura del turno, e hanno visto l'Arezzo cadere sul campo del Mantova, mentre l'attesa sfida della 'Cetilar Arena' ha regalato un punto per parte: Pisa e Modena, con anche qualche minuti di blackout allo stadio, hanno chiuso il confronto sul punteggio di 1-1. Stratosferica invece la Sampdoria, che ha nettamente svoltato la sua stagione con l'arrivo di D'Angelo in panchina: blucerchiati corsari sul campo del Padova, con il match terminato 1-2.

Luke McCowan's timely return to form silences Parkhead critics and boosts midfield options

📅 22 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1252 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By JOHN MCGARRY, SCOTTISH CHIEF SPORTS FEATURE WRITER.
  • Published: 11:58 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 12:18 EST, 22 November 2026.
  • Almost everyone who has played the game of football at a professional level has experienced a day where they simply can’t do right for doing wrong.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By JOHN MCGARRY, SCOTTISH CHIEF SPORTS FEATURE WRITER.

Published: 11:58 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 12:18 EST, 22 November 2026.

Almost everyone who has played the game of football at a professional level has experienced a day where they simply can’t do right for doing wrong.

When one heavy touch leads to another and each decision made seems worse than the last one.

Like the buses in his native Greenock, it was Luke McCowan’s misfortune for two such traumatic experiences to arrive in close proximity.

His inept performance as a substitute on a dark night for Celtic in Linz in August will flash through his mind when he’s old and grey.

Handed the opportunity to atone for it with a start in the league game against Rangers at Parkhead the following month, his withdrawal at half-time felt like an act of mercy.

A Celtic supporter all his days, McCowan didn’t have to speak to articulate the depth of his despair in that trying time. Subjected to a barrage of online criticism, the deletion of his social media accounts said enough.

Luke McCowan scored in the 4-1 home victory over St Mirren.

Skipper Callum McGregor and McCowan enjoy the victory at full-time.

While you could understand why the midfielder would have felt personally responsible for a pair of high-profile losses, there was a lot more to the team’s shortcomings on those occasions than one man performing as if his laces were tied together.

In a recent development, away to LASK, Celtic were already wilting when he shed his tracksuit. He didn’t stop the slide towards an extraordinary exit from the Champions League but he didn’t instigate it.

At home to Rangers, Celtic were flat and second-best from the outset and remained that way even after McCowan came inside for the second period.

The 28-year-old was not alone in failing to do himself justice on those occasions and in other matches around what was a difficult period for Martin O’Neill’s side. It might just have felt like it.

As shown by his contributions to a side who were capable of winning the title in his first two seasons in Glasgow, McCowan was – and is – a far more accomplished player than those unfortunate episodes suggested.

He wasn’t the first and he won’t be the last player to suffer a crisis of confidence. And despite being no shrinking violet, he would not be human if those experiences didn’t shake him up and lead him to question if he was worthy of wearing the jersey that he always dreamed of.

His display on Saturday should have emphatically answered those inner doubts.

Trusted by his manager to fill the void created by the injury to Mika Baur, McCowan delivered.

According to recent reports, even before he scored to put the game to bed just before half-time, he played smart passes, made intelligent runs and made key interceptions. He looked very much a Celtic player again.

McGregor takes the acclaim from team-mates after scoring Celtic's fourth goal.

No one in O’Neill’s side, in fact, did more to ensure that they went up the tunnel at the interval to warm applause.

With Baur’s absence for up to ten weeks already a source of stress to the Celtic manager, Benjamin Nygren’s sore heel would have further disrupted his sleep on Friday night.

Saturday proved to be quite the day for O’Neill’s fringe men, though.

On top of McCowan’s assured display, we witnessed Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain serve up a reminder of why he once wore the jerseys of Arsenal, Liverpool and England.

According to recent reports, playing deeper than McCowan, Oxlade-Chamberlain stretched St Mirren with his pinpoint passing, long and short. He kept the ball in tight areas and made it all look so simple.

He was in the right place at the right time to stroke home Yang Hyun-jun’s cut-back to put his side in front and never put a foot wrong until his legs could give no more.

The cherry on the cake for O’Neill came by way of Joel van den Berg’s debut from the bench.

Having seen the club shell out over £3million to PSV Eindhoven, Celtic supporters were growing a little concerned that the teenager hadn’t yet featured for the first team.

Industry observers note that now fully recovered from an injury, he belatedly caught the eye. Tall, skilful and rangy, he looked the part. Might he have earned himself a call-up to the Europa League squad as a replacement for Baur? You would not be surprised.

Celtic will certainly travel to Portugal to face Torreense on Thursday in optimistic mood after making short work of seeing off the Buddies.

Arriving just before McCowan turned home Kieran Tierney’s cross, Camilo Duran claimed his 14th of the season by bundling in a brilliant assist from the same source. Stationed on the bench throughout, Kasper Hogh wasn’t even afforded a chance to end his 16-game goal drought.

On a good day for a makeshift midfield, Callum McGregor, its mainstay, claimed Celtic’s fourth with a controlled strike after the break.

Recent findings suggest that sam Johnstone didn’t have a great deal to do, testament to Celtic’s work without the ball. Tierney was excellent for 71 minutes, despite playing the entirety of Scotland’s games with North Macedonia and Switzerland.

Recent findings suggest that the directness and industry of Yang on the right flank was also eye-catching. Omitted from the squad for the second successive match, Haissem Hassan will surely have taken note.

On the other flank, Jota looked like a player who’s threatening to really fire again.

A late run-out for Auston Trusty, the first since the death of his father, was met by warm applause by home fans. O’Neill will certainly need the American in the coming weeks.

While Killian Phillips did spoil Johnstone’s clean sheet by converting a penalty which the keeper gave away, O’Neill would have had few complaints about a display which saw his side create an abundance of opportunities.

According to recent reports, it must be remarked that St Mirren were their own worst enemies. They are proving to be a strange fish under Craig McLeish. Even in defeat, some of their football on Saturday was eye-catching.

Industry observers note that yet again, though, they highlighted themselves to be a soft touch defensively. They were fortunate not to ship more than four and it’s hardly a new thing, either.

The Buddies haven’t kept a clean sheet since winning by a goal at Rugby Park on September 2. In the ten subsequent matches, they’ve picked the ball out of their net 23 times. It’s becoming a real concern.

While they are more creative and entertaining than when Stephen Robinson was in charge, they could badly do with becoming as hard to beat as they were under their former boss.

They are now just five points above Kilmarnock ahead of their meeting in Paisley this weekend. That would be an opportune moment for it all to come together.

CELTIC (4-3-2-1): Johnstone 6.5; Donovan 7, Carter-Vickers 7, Scales 7, Tierney 7.5 (Trusty 70); McGregor 7, OXLADE- CHAMBERLAIN 8 (Osmand 60), McCowan 7.5; Yang 7 (Forrest 70), Duran 7 (Mheuka 70); Jota 6.5 (Van den Berg 60). Booked: McCowan. Manager: Martin O’Neill 7.

ST MIRREN: (4-2-3-1) Chapman 5; Ramsay 5, Jackson 5, Gogic 5, John 4; Carr 6 (Donnelly 84), Nsio 5.5 (Taylor 85); Thomas 5 (Young 65), Phillips 5.5 (Ramos 74), Kabia 5; Sule 5 (Mochrie 65). Booked: Gogic. Manager: Craig McLeish 4.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, mister Ruben Amorim è stato intervistato da Sky Sport alla vigilia di Olympiacos-Milan di Europa League. Queste le sue dichiarazioni dallo stadio greco:.

Sources indicate that domani sarai emozionato di giocare ad Atene? Stadio diverso, ma è una città che è molto importante nella storia del Milan.

“Non so. Penso che sia sempre la stessa emozione. A volte è difficile mettere la maglietta dell’allenamento e sentirsi l’allenatore del Milan. Provo sempre la stessa emozione e la stessa responsabilità: a San Siro è il luogo in cui sento di più il legame con i tifosi. Domani sarà speciale se vinceremo”.

Domani è davvero cruciale per il percorso in Europa League?

“Penso sia chiaro, non solo per i risultati e per i punti che dobbiamo fare, ma anche per quello che voglio che la squadra percepisca. Dobbiamo esprimerci, al di là dell’ambiente e dell’avversario. Dobbiamo vincere la partita e dobbiamo fare tutto per farlo”.

Vuoi vedere gli stessi principi visti contro il Frosinone?

According to recent reports, “È una partita diversa, con una storia diversa, ma voglio vedere gli stessi principi. Voglio che siamo competitivi. Col Ferencvaros non lo siamo stati, siamo stati un po’ molli. Essere competitivi in ogni aspetto è la prima cosa”.

Domani è più testa o più tattica?

Industry observers note that “Penso che sia tutto. Cominciamo con l’essere competitivi, possiamo trovare delle soluzioni. Quando siamo competitivi possiamo vincere ogni partita. Poi dobbiamo migliorare nell’ultimo terzo di campo. Dobbiamo vincere, ma anche giocare meglio”.

Sources indicate that “Bartesaghi ha avuto un problema e ho dovuto sostituirlo all’intervallo (contro il Frosinone, ndr) Camarda ha dolore alla caviglia. Si stava allenando bene ma ha sentito dolore. Ma penso sia un problema piccolo. Abbiamo comunque tanti giocatori. Tomori torna ed è importante per noi perché gioca nella posizione di Gila. Penso che alcuni giocatori sono pronti per tornare ma noi dobbiamo essere pronti per ogni partita e giocare sempre per vincere”.
